extraction.NOTES: Administrative cover letter dated February 18, 1929, from Pine Ridge Agency to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs regarding Circular 2464 Fee Patent Data. States that patents were issued to 682 Indians without their applications; 306 have responded to a letter requesting them to call at the office and make affidavit. Another letter to be mailed to non-respondents. Document references file numbers 5-114-2 and 312. Notes that a sample page containing data for 11 Indians and supporting papers was enclosed for approval before the complete list is prepared.
